inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev16 PROGRESSIVE UFO classic, dev15 GIGANTIC UFO, dev14 CENTIPEDE, dev13 VERTEBRATE, dev12 UNKNOWN, dev11 BUTTERFLY, dev10 HORNET, dev9 ULTIMATE UFO, dev8 MANDALA and earlier native-format/mod/source-only gates remain inherited. Dev17 adds SQUID without changing prior assembly catalogs.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, then passed 99/99 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and SQUID two-phase checks.

final_package.note: Final package is produced as a fixed-metadata deterministic ZIP pair and one untouched fresh extraction is re-audited and executed after the pair matches.

limitations: SQUID helper/control runtime records 9..13 are not GMX assets and are deliberately excluded from model assembly.
The phase presets model proved runtime visibility/membership; they do not serialize non-GMX effects or controls into glTF.
Fresh retail Xbox game data was used only for external validation; no proprietary package, GMX, or generated retail glTF is bundled.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
